title: Agree separate correctness and noise-robustness checks for M1
summary: James approved noise-free geometry/export verification followed by a separately identified check using the existing sensor noise model. Noise-free means disabling measurement and ray-direction perturbations. Numerical thresholds, fixture details and assignment remain open; these simulation checks do not qualify real survey accuracy or resume research.
